nubank-violet.$description: Nubank Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

dusty-violet.$description: Dusty Violet — Subtle violet washes, disabled violet states, muted brand backgrounds

ink.$description: Ink — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

snow.$description: Snow — Card surfaces, input fills, text on dark backgrounds, page sections over the mist base

mist.$description: Mist — Page canvas, subtle section backgrounds, input field fills — the porcelain tone that defines the overall light theme

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary text, helper labels, placeholder text, icon strokes at rest

concrete.$description: Concrete — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle UI separators

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, footer secondary lines, metadata

graphite.$description: Graphite — Mid-neutral fills, muted backgrounds for nested sections

graphik.$description: All interface text — headings, body, buttons, inputs, navigation. The custom geometric sans with weights limited to 400-500 is deliberate: no bold ever appears, so weight contrast is replaced by size contrast, creating a system that whispers through scale rather than shouts through heaviness.
